subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should maintainers split this issue into a core reset/session-state fix plus separate UX/diagnostic follow-ups, or keep the whole empty-delivery/reset cluster as one sponsored work item?
rationale: The source-backed bug is real, but the issue also asks for new user-facing heartbeat behavior, a transcript schema diagnostic, and reset help text, which should not be bundled into one unsupervised fix without maintainer scoping.

options.title: Split and fix invariant first
options.body: Track the reset transcript/store ordering and inbound missing-file self-heal as the immediate bug fix, with optional UX diagnostics moved to follow-ups.

options.title: Sponsor one umbrella fix
options.body: Keep the issue as the canonical owner for reset ordering, delivery fallback, progress, usage diagnostics, and reset documentation, accepting a larger multi-area change.

options.title: Route to a narrower canonical issue
options.body: If maintainers already have a private or newer canonical root-cause item, close this only after linking that open owner and preserving the reporter's evidence there.

recommendation.title: Split and fix invariant first
recommendation.body: Track the reset transcript/store ordering and inbound missing-file self-heal as the immediate bug fix, with optional UX diagnostics moved to follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The current inspected lifecycle and session code is attributed to Goutam Adwant in local blame, making them the best available routing candidate for the scope decision.
